notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR7: "Debugging lines are permitted within library text and pseudo-text" and their text words "participate in the matching rules as if the 'D' did not appear in the indicator area"; a debugging line is within pseudo-text if it begins after the opening delimiter and before the closing one. FixedFormConverter writes a D line as DebugLineCarrier plus its text in library text and in the COPY statement alike, TextWordScanner skips the carrier and scans the text, so ApplyReplacements matches its words with or without WITH DEBUGGING MODE; only after replacement does DebuggingLineRewriter hide the lines that are still debugging lines when the mode is off. Witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-7 (a D line inside pseudo-text-1 and in library text, both modes). Probes (work-rd-06/p): p7a pseudo-text-1 WS-A. MOVE 2 matches across a library source line and D line, pseudo-text-2 holding its own D line, and ==3 TO / D WS-C== matches a source line: 1060 without, 1465 with DEBUGGING MODE (the D-line words of pseudo-text-2 and the unmatched TO WS-B. stay on debugging lines); p7b a D line holding the closing delimiter of pseudo-text-1 still matches (1080 / 1280); p9f a COPY on a D line (A B / A LIB1 LIB2 B); b/c) p3r, p3e as GR3. || REFUTED: PARTIAL - harm rejects-legal-source: with WITH DEBUGGING MODE, a debugging line within pseudo-text-2 whose words replace a word in the middle of a library line is refused COBOL7061 although the program is syntactically correct with and without its debugging lines. next.reason: Amendment 1 (X3.23a-1989) only respelled 'pseudo-text-delimiter' as 'pseudo-text delimiter' twice, a typographical correction; the requirement is unchanged: §1985:XII.2.4 GR7 'Debugging lines are permitted within library text and pseudo-text', their text words 'participate in the matching rules as if the 'D' did not appear in the indicator area'. 2023 has no debugging lines: the phrase occurs nowhere in the standard, its fixed indicators (§2023:6.2.2) are the comment indicators, the continuation indicator and the space source indicator for 'any line that is not a comment line or a continuation line', and §2023:6.5 GR5 copies only 'a fixed-form line, contains a source indicator, and is not a continuation line'. No 2023 rule lets a 'D' line appear in library text or pseudo-text or has its words take part in matching.
